styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Harbourside museums, the SS Great Britain and street life.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Stokes Croft cafés, street food markets and cider pubs.

styles.label: History
styles.blurb: Old City, the harbour and Brunel's engineering.

stays.why: Walk to the SS Great Britain, M Shed and the waterfront bars. Quiet at night but close to everything.
Central for St Nicholas Market, the harbour and Temple Meads. Best if you want to walk everywhere.
Leafy streets, the Suspension Bridge and the university. Village feel, 20–30 min walk or a short bus to the centre.
Cheapest and handiest for trains and coaches. 15 min walk to the centre; good for short stays.

food: Try a West Country pasty and a proper cider. Ask for dry or sweet; cider here is stronger than you expect.
St Nicholas Market in the Old City has cheap global street food at lunch, roughly £6–12 a portion.
Stokes Croft and Gloucester Road are the independent café and brunch strips. Expect queues at weekends.
Book ahead for dinner on Friday and Saturday. Popular Harbourside and Clifton places fill up.
Look for local produce: Somerset cheese, Severn salmon and Bristol-made beer. Check menus for what's in season.
more_time: Swap a city afternoon for the Clifton Suspension Bridge and the Downs: walk or take a short bus, then tea in Clifton Village.
Take the train to Bath (about 15 min from Temple Meads) for Roman baths and Georgian streets. Check times on the day.
Head to the Severn Beach rail line for a half-day out to Avonmouth or the coast. Simple, cheap and car-free.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the Harbourside, Old City and Clifton at an easy pace. Add a night for a Bath day trip.

month_notes: Coldest month: highs near 8°C, lows near 2°C. Pack a warm coat and expect 13 rain days.
Still cold, highs around 9°C. Quiet season with cheaper rooms.
Cool and wet: about 15 rain days, the wettest of the year. Bring a waterproof.
Milder at around 13°C. Fewer rain days (about 10), good for walking.
Pleasant spring: highs near 16°C. Pack layers for cool evenings.
Warm start to summer, highs around 19°C. Long evenings outdoors.
Warmest month: highs near 21°C, lows near 13°C. Book dinner ahead.
Similar to July, around 20°C. Busy with festivals; check on the day.
Cooling to about 18°C. Still good for the harbour and parks.
Autumn: highs near 15°C, about 14 rain days. Bring a rain jacket.
Cooler at around 11°C with 14 rain days. Dark by late afternoon.
Cold again: highs near 9°C, lows near 4°C, 15 rain days. Christmas markets draw crowds.

climate_guide.summary: Temperate maritime climate: mild, often cloudy and rain in any month. Rarely very hot or very cold.

items.title: Best time: May to September
items.text: Highs of 16–21°C and long daylight. Best for walking the harbour and Clifton.

items.title: Rain all year
items.text: Expect 10–15 rain days every month. Showers pass quickly; carry a small umbrella or waterproof.

items.title: Mild winters
items.text: January and February highs near 8–9°C, lows near 2–4°C. Frost is possible but snow is rare.

items.title: Layers work best
items.text: Days can warm up then cool fast. A light jacket and a warm mid-layer cover most trips.

items.title: Summer is gentle
items.text: July peaks near 21°C. No need for air-conditioning; evenings stay around 13°C.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Waterproof jacket, comfortable walking shoes for hills and cobbles, and a warm layer for evenings.

transit.best: Walk the centre and Harbourside; use buses or e-scooters for Clifton and longer hops.

modes.text: No metro or tram in Bristol. Don't plan around rail inside the city.
Buses cover the centre and suburbs. Contactless tap fares are around £2–3.
The Severn Beach line links Temple Meads with Clifton Down and Avonmouth. Handy for a car-free day out.
Taxis are common; Uber and Bolt both operate in Bristol.
Driving is slow in the centre. Use Park and Ride at Portway, Brislington or Long Ashton.
The centre and Harbourside are easy on foot. Temple Meads is about a 15 min walk.
Dott e-scooters and e-bikes cost £0.99 to unlock plus about £0.16 per minute.
